title: Dark Pact
wikitext:
'''Dark Pact''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The Lurker at the Threshold]] expansion.

When the [[Lurker at the Threshold (herald)|Lurker at the Threshold]] is being used as a [[herald]], [[investigator]]s may take Dark Pacts. Though an investigator may take multiple Dark Pacts, he can never have more than one of the same type. Possessing a Dark Pact allows an investigator to spend [[Power token]]s. The purposes for which Power tokens can be used are dependent on the type of Dark Pact possessed by the investigator. Dark Pacts provide both benefits and drawbacks unique to their type. Having a Dark Pact can also subject an investigator to particular effects from the [[Reckoning]] deck, both for good and ill.

==List of Dark Pacts==

*[[Blood Pact]]
*[[Bound Ally]]
*[[Soul Pact]]
